more than 7 texts. [4]

$L_1:\boldsymbol{r}_1=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\\2\end{pmatrix}+\lambda\begin{pmatrix}-1\\1\\2\end{pmatrix}$
$L_2:\boldsymbol{r}_2=\begin{pmatrix}1\\2\\4\end{pmatrix}+\mu\begin{pmatrix}2\\1\\6\end{pmatrix}$.
(a) Show that the lines $L_1$ and $L_2$ are skew. [4]
(b) Find the acute angle between the lines $L_1$ and $L_2$. [4]
(c) (i) Find a vector perpendicular to both lines.
(ii) Hence determine an equation of the line $L_3$ that is perpendicular to both $L_1$ and $L_2$ and intersects both lines. [10]
